WITH invoice_gender_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.gender, 'MISSING') AS gender,
    COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(c.gender, 'MISSING')
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count
  FROM invoice_gender_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    igc.invoice_count,
    igc.invoice_count - oa.avg_invoice_count AS excess
  FROM invoice_gender_counts igc
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE igc.invoice_count > oa.avg_invoice_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_of_above_average_counts,
  AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_overall_average
FROM above_average
